steps.action: on en.wikipedia.org 'Quadrature amplitude modulation' right-clicks the page; context menu with a Mini Window entry
picks the mini-window option: overlay 'Select part of the page to keep visible' and a chooser 'Choose what to move to a Mini Window' (selected area / full tab)
drags a region around the second paragraph ('The two carrier waves...') plus part of the infobox, 948x156; clicks 'Move to Mini Window'
page returns to normal, then switches to a New Tab where the mini window sits at the bottom (06.2-10.0)
repeats on monkeytype.com: right-click (11.8), mini-window option (12.8), selects the three lines of typing words, 1280x158 (14.5-16.8), clicks 'Move to Mini Window' (17.2)
New Tab with the monkeytype mini window at the bottom until the end (22.8)

actual: Wikipedia: the mini window (06.2-10.0) shows the top of the page (Wikipedia logo, Search box, start of the title 'Quadrature amplitude modulation'), not the selected paragraph. Monkeytype: the mini window is dark/empty at 18.0-21.0, briefly shows the selected word lines at 21.2-21.8, and when hovered (22.0-22.8) shows the monkeytype header from the top of the page. An overlaid caption added by the author reads 'doesnt show cropped selection. shows other part of webpage'.
decisive: 00:06.5-00:10.0: mini window shows the Wikipedia header and page title, while the selection made at 00:04.5 was the 'The two carrier waves...' paragraph in the middle of the page
